data.animaCaption: Leaning back in the dressing-room chair with one stockinged leg extended toward the camera, she adjusts her ribbon-tied black thighhigh with both hands and meets your gaze with parted lips. Warm vanity mirror bulbs cast a golden rim across her lavender embroidered lace and long dark hair.
data.promptProse: Rendered in a dramatic wide-angle tilted overhead shot inside a quiet backstage dressing room, Shiki Natsume leans back on a folding chair beside grey metal lockers and a bulb-lit vanity mirror. Wearing delicate lavender floral-embroidered lingerie and ribbon-tied black thighhighs, she extends one leg toward the foreground while both hands smooth the top of the other stocking up her thigh, looking toward the camera with parted lips and a warm blush as the glowing vanity bulbs rim her hair and lace.
data.story: 后台更衣室的化妆镜灯串亮着暖黄的光。靠在折椅上的夏目正伸手把黑丝袜口拉平，察觉你推门而入却没有慌乱躲闪，只带着一点微红的脸颊轻启唇角——「门都不敲就进来……既然看见了，就别急着移开视线。」
